title: Book Three · Chapter 75: Dad at Two
story:
On Tuesday, Ronan comes home and finds Dad in the yard.

His work bag is beside the chair. He is washing dust from his hands.

Ronan stops at the gate.

“Are you ill?”

“No. Only earlier.”

Dad dries his hands and comes inside. Mum moves a piece of cloth away from the spare chair.

“We need to look at this,” Dad says.

He takes out a sheet from Mr Sun. For the next four weeks, he will finish at two on Tuesdays and Thursdays. The other work days stay the same.

“Two instead of five,” he tells Mum.

“Less work?”

“Fewer jobs waiting this month. Mr Sun will look at the hours again after four weeks.”

Mum reads the sheet. Then she takes out her household envelope.

Ronan leaves his school bag by the door. He stays near the table.

“Less pay too?” he asks.

Dad nods.

Mum puts two pieces of paper beside each other. She writes the usual house costs first. Then she looks at the cloth and thread money.

“We can wait on the other cloth,” she says. “I have enough for the current work.”

Dad shows her his short tool list.

“And this can wait.”

They talk for a while. Rent and food stay at the top of the page. Neither asks Ronan for his small envelope.

“I can do more trips,” he says.

Mum looks up.

“One or two on Saturday, as before. I still have my own work.”

Dad points to the two early afternoons.

“I can take some things on the way home. We will work it out.”

Ronan looks at the coat beside Mum's chair. It does not seem to need him at once.

He takes his books to the window and begins the first question. Behind him, Mum and Dad change two lines on the page.

Later, Dad comes to look at his work. He has a cup in each hand.

“An early cup,” he says.

Ronan takes one. “Will you be here every Tuesday?”

“For this month. Unless Mr Sun needs a full day.”

“I may need the table.”

Dad looks at the books, then at Mum's cloth.

“I can stand in the yard.”

Mum laughs from her chair. “You can sit. We own more than one chair.”

Dad takes his cup outside. Ronan watches him pull the chair into a patch of light.

The house is quieter after that. Mum's needle moves through the coat. Ronan turns a page. Outside, Dad opens his own book and stays in the afternoon sun for a little while.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pay＝工资、报酬；rent＝房租；current＝目前的；work something out＝设法安排妥当。

## 理解问题

1. Dad的哪两天、哪个时刻有变化？他是否失去了工作或生病了？
2. 家庭怎样先处理必要开销？有没有要求Ronan承担全部缺口？

## 读句子

**He has a cup in each hand.**

拆开看：He / has a cup / in each hand.

他／各拿着一只杯子／一只手里一只。
